title: Ok butter dish - room for improvement
text: Ok butter dish - room for improvement. Nice plastic butter dish with a clear lid.  Wish it "snapped" the lid on instead of just resting on the base.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Butter Dish
features: Stoppers on either side of dish keep butter in place while cutting
Clear lid rests on Dish without sliding off during transport and is easy to remove
Dish designed to keep butter from slipping off tray and dirtying lid
Accommodates all short and long butter sticks
description: Our Butter Dish has stoppers on three sides to keep sticks from sliding around as you cut them. Accommodates longer, slimmer sticks (the dominant shape east of the Rocky Mountains) as well as shorter, stouter sticks (commonly found out West), with measurement markings for each.
